content:
# Customer — Lumen Labs

A growing operations analytics company, and our largest upcoming renewal.

- Contact: Priya Raman.
- Usage up 38% since February; compliance workspace added in June.
- Open case: scheduled export stops at two minutes. With engineering, high priority.
  Owner Samira. Next action: send the workaround before 15:00 and update after the
  cancellation test.
- Invoice 4471: 412.00 USD, open, due 30 August. Not overdue.

#lumen #customer

# Meeting summary — Lumen incident triage

Samira, Lucas, Jon.

- Priya gave us a clean boundary: 48k rows finishes in 1m34s, 52k reaches the two-minute
  worker limit. Interactive retry works, scheduled retry does not.
- Lucas reproduced it. The scheduler still passes the old timeout to the export worker.
  The fix is small; the load test is not.
- Noor: invoice 4471 is open but not overdue until the 30th. Keep billing out of the
  incident reply unless Priya asks.

Outcome: Samira sends the manual-retry workaround and promises no release date.

#lumen #support #meeting

# Decision — do not merge the export fix on the small fixture alone

Jon, in the lumen-renewal channel:

> Please do not merge on the small fixture alone. Run 50k, 75k, and a cancelled job.
> If cancellation leaks workers, 2.8 waits.

Agreed. 50k and 75k are done. The cancelled job is the one that is still open, so this
decision is what is holding the release date rather than the fix itself.

#release-2-8 #decision

# Customer — Ember Commerce

An online retailer that uses scheduled exports for fulfilment reporting.

- Contact: Ravi Okonkwo.
- Open case: CSV header order changed after a connector update. Normal priority,
  owner Samira, waiting on the customer.
- Next action is theirs: we need the saved export id from Ravi before we can look.

Not urgent, but it has been sitting since the 19th. Worth a nudge if Tuesday is quiet.

#support #customer

# Theo — first week

Imani owns this.

- [x] Laptop
- [x] Email and chat
- [ ] Staging access — owner not assigned
- [x] Architecture session with Jon
- [x] Pairing block with Hana

Imani left the owner blank because she does not know whether Jon or Lucas is handling
staging access. Neither has picked it up. Theo starts before the go or no-go, so this
needs an owner today rather than Monday.

Welcome session is Monday 24 August, 09:30.

#onboarding

# Meeting summary — audit page review

Hana walked the audit page.

- Copy is final. Elena is happy to ship it.
- One bug found: the audit export labels timestamps as UTC after a local conversion.
  The value is correct, the label is not.
- Hana opened issue 322 and deliberately kept it out of the export branch, so it cannot
  delay the timeout decision.

Outcome: the audit work is not on the critical path. Only the export timeout is.

#release-2-8 #meeting

# Release 2.8 — open blockers

- [ ] relay-core issue 318 — scheduled exports keep the legacy 120s worker timeout.
      The fix exists. It is the tests that are open.
- [ ] exports-service issue 319 — add the cancellation case to the large-export load fixture.
      This is the one that decides Monday.
- [ ] web-console issue 322 — audit export labels timestamps as UTC after local conversion.
      Visual only, kept off the export branch, does not block.

Two of these can ship late. Issue 319 cannot.

#release-2-8

# Lumen renewal brief — working draft

Usage is up 38% since February. The compliance workspace was added in June.

## Export incident

TODO: Replace after engineering go/no-go. Do not promise 2.8 until load and cancellation tests pass.

## Billing

Invoice 4471: 412.00 USD, open, due 30 August. Not overdue.

David owns the draft; I own the paragraph above. #lumen #customer

# August month-end

Noor is closing the books.

- Expenses were due Friday 16:00. Missing receipts can wait until Monday; the amount and
  the customer still have to be entered on the day.
- Customer balances need to be clear before the Lumen review, so nobody walks into
  Tuesday with an open invoice they have not seen.
- Target close: 3 September.

#finance

# Agenda — 2.8 go or no-go

Monday 24 August, 11:30–12:00. Jon, Elena, Lucas.

One question: does the export timeout fix enter 2.8?

- [x] 50k-row export test
- [x] 75k-row export test
- [ ] Cancelled 75k-row run leaves no partial object

If the third is not green by Monday morning, the answer is no and the audit work ships
on its own. Elena needs the answer by noon.

#release-2-8 #meeting

# Agenda — Lumen renewal review

Tuesday 25 August, 14:00–14:45 London. Me, David, Priya Raman.

Renewal, export reliability, usage growth, next-quarter plan.

- Lead with the usage growth and the compliance workspace.
- Give the export answer engineering actually has, not the one Priya wants.
- Invoice 4471 is a billing item, not an incident item. Only raise it if Priya does.

#lumen #meeting

# This week

Three things are open and only one of them is comfortable.

- **Lumen renewal** — review is Tuesday. The brief still has a placeholder where the export answer goes. #lumen
- **Release 2.8** — go or no-go is Monday at 11:30. Cancellation cleanup is the last blocker. #release-2-8
- **Theo starts** — his first week is planned; staging access still has no owner. #onboarding

The renewal brief must not promise a 2.8 date before the go or no-go.
